channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Amazon is not happy with Saks
item.description: Amazon said its $475M stake in Saks is 'presumptively worthless' and that it may seek 'more drastic remedies' if Saks doesn't 'resolve' its concerns.

item.title: It was surprisingly easy to get Grok to undress me
item.description: Grok users can still make sexualized images within the app, just not via the @Grok account on X. I tested it out and learned how easy it is.

item.title: THEN AND NOW: Vintage photos show how department stores have changed
item.description: Department stores once sold necessities. Now, many are struggling to remain in business amid the rise of online shopping.

item.title: A Ford worker heckled Trump. His suspension is a reminder that free speech can get you in trouble at work.
item.description: The advice from five legal experts boiled down to a blunt workplace reality: employees should watch their mouth if they want to keep their job.

item.title: Jamie Dimon says he called Warren Buffett after poaching his protégé
item.description: Dimon also said he would "absolutely, positively, no chance, no way, no how for any reason" serve as Fed Chair.

item.title: Ashley St. Clair sues Elon Musk's xAI over alleged explicit Grok deepfake images
item.description: Ashley St. Clair is suing Elon Musk's AI startup, alleging the chatbot Grok generated explicit photos of her.

item.title: Plane chaos erupts after passenger puts a bomb threat in their mobile hotspot name
item.description: The plane's crew detected a passenger's hot spot that had a bomb threat in its name.

item.title: Macron says Ukraine now relies on France, instead of the US, for intelligence
item.description: Macron said that Ukraine was previously "overwhelmingly dependent" on US intelligence, but that France is now providing "two-thirds" of that service.

item.title: For this mom, moving to work in South Korea felt like a 'full-circle moment' — even if it came with one sacrifice
item.description: Motolani Adedipe moved to South Korea for a year on a Fulbright scholarship. She brought her two kids along while her husband remained in the US.

item.title: ICE arrested 2 truck drivers heading to a major Meta data center project
item.description: ICE arrested two truck drivers on Wednesday during a traffic stop inspection of vehicles heading to a Meta construction project.
